intro: Jannok Breezesong is a night elf rogue trainer stationed in the village of Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He offers instruction in stealth, cunning, and bladecraft to young kaldorei rogues venturing out into the boughs of the World Tree.

p: Found lounging beneath the boughs of Dolanaar, Jannok Breezesong serves as the primary instructor for novice night elf rogues. Unlike the formal sentinels or cloistered druids of Teldrassil, Jannok guides those who operate quietly on the fringes of society, teaching them how to stalk the shadows, strike from behind, and survive unseen amidst the boughs. Once a rogue has advanced beyond initial lessons in Dolanaar, Jannok directs them onward to more experienced masters in the capital city of Darnassus.
